en.title: Short answers and question tags
en.summary: A short answer repeats the auxiliary; a question tag asks for agreement.

paragraphs: A short answer repeats the auxiliary. A question tag is a short question added to a statement to ask for agreement.
A tag has the same auxiliary as the statement but the opposite meaning: a positive statement has a negative tag, and a negative statement has a positive tag.

blocks.html:
StatementTag
It is cold,isn't it?
You can swim,can't you?
They didn't come,did they?
